_about: Friends you can call to hang out (src/progression/companions.js). Unlocked at 10 hearts once their favour (npcs.json questItems) is done. boost: luck (rarer fish), quick (bites sooner), skill (+25% that skill's XP) or xp (+10% XP). number: what they say when they give it. Their hangout lines are in companion-lines.json.

bram.number: You did it. Not many would bother. Here, my number. Call me up if you ever want to fish together.

oda.number: You brought it all. You listen to the cold. Here is my number. Call for me when you want company on the water.

wen.number: You remembered! Take my number. Call me and we will feed the water together.

ines.number: You are the best. Here, my number. Call me, and I will tell you what is down there.

mara.number: That's everything. You're a proper friend. My number. Shout if you ever want a hand on the water.

tal.number: A feast! Take my number. Call me if you want to find good stuff.

rook.number: Hm. Not bad. Fine. My number. Call if you need a lookout.

dune.number: You actually found it all. Here's my number. Call me and I'll show you places.

sefu.number: You kept your word. Here, my number. Call me, and I will bring my stories.

yuki.number: You are wonderful. Here is my number. Call me, I would love to come along.
